name: Prompt Vocabulary
description: A broad English image-generation vocabulary organized by functional category for agent-selected prompt construction. Terms are danbooru and e621 tag vocabulary with a one-line description of the effect each has on a picture. A large part of the observed effects follows the Japanese prompt dictionaries published by studiomasakaki on pixivFANBOX (the 2024 edition for AnimagineXL and NovelAI v3, and the 2025 edition for illustrious-family models), paraphrased in English; an effect that was only observed on one model family is noted as such.

categories.name: Negative Prompts
categories.description: Terms commonly used in negative prompts to discourage unwanted output characteristics.

entries.description: Negative with comic to stop the picture splitting into panels.
Negative against dreamy abstraction and stray patterns; usable in the positive too, and abstract background for the backdrop.
Negative cue against flat TV-frame screencap composition.
Writes the creator name in visible lettering across part of the image.
Negative for images with drawing mistakes.
A general negative that raises quality; combines with a part as bad face, bad hands, bad legs, bad feet.
Distorts the body with wrong proportions, misplaced joints, impossible bends, and mismatched parts.
Renders a poorly drawn face with muddy features, broken symmetry, and indistinct eyes or mouth.
Renders fingers with the wrong count, odd lengths, or bends that fold in impossible directions.
Draws hands with fused or twisted fingers, the wrong joint count, and shapeless palms.
Softens the entire frame so outlines and textures lose definition and everything looks smeared.
Cuts the composition off at the frame edge so part of the subject falls outside the picture.
Negative to remove the internal cut-in that explicit content often adds.
Prints a calendar date in small text, often in a corner like a camera timestamp.
Negative to remove a date written in a corner.
Renders mismatched or warped eyes with the wrong size, uneven placement, or unnatural pupils.
Warps the figure into grotesque wrong shapes with twisted limbs, melted features, and asymmetrical misplaced parts.
Renders limbs attached at wrong points or separated from the torso by a visible gap.
Negative for unpleasant images.
Shows glitchy rendering mistakes such as blocky patches, scrambled pixels, and broken geometry where detail should be.
Negative for images with too many limbs or digits.
Adds an additional finger or toe beyond the natural five on the hand or foot.
Adds arms beyond the natural pair, sprouting from the back, shoulders, or torso in odd positions.
Adds more than five fingers to a hand, often doubling digits at the knuckles.
Adds legs beyond the natural pair, duplicating thighs and calves in strange positions.
Negative for images with too few limbs or digits.
Reduces the finger or toe count below five, leaving a shortened or incomplete hand.
Draws hands or feet hovering beside the body with no connecting arm or leg at all.
Runs a strip of small text or graphics along the bottom edge of the image.
Runs a banner of text or graphics along the top edge of the image.
Draws an arm or leg with the wrong length, bend, or joint placement, reading as physically impossible.
Adds blocky compression squares, ringing around edges, and smudged color typical of a heavily compressed file.
Melts the fingers together into a soft dripping blob with no distinct separations.
Stamps a brand mark or emblem onto the image surface, usually small and high contrast.
Stretches the torso so the midsection appears unnaturally long compared with the limbs and head.
Elongates the neck far beyond natural proportion so the head sits unnaturally high above the shoulders.
Degrades the image with soft edges, washed out color, noise, and visible loss of fine texture.
Drops the resolution so edges turn jagged, textures flatten, and fine elements blur into coarse pixels.
Draws hands with warped structure, fingers bending the wrong direction or fusing together.
Negative for images with missing limbs or digits.
Omits one or both arms entirely, leaving bare shoulders or an empty gap at the sides.
Leaves one or more fingers absent so the hand shows too few digits.
Leaves an arm or leg absent entirely, ending in nothing where the limb should attach to the body.
Twists the hands into fleshy malformed shapes with swollen knuckles, merged fingers, and impossible angles.
As a negative it stops the camera pulling too far back; in the positive it leaves wide empty space in the frame.
Shows the small raised darker areola and nipple on an exposed breast, rendered plainly and anatomically.
Marks adult oriented content, typically showing nudity, explicit exposure, or sexual activity in the image.
Blurs the subject so edges dissolve and details smear into soft indistinct shapes.
Shows only a fragment of the face, the rest cut away by the framing or left unfinished.
Frames only part of the head, with the skull or jaw cut off by the image edge.
Sketches fingers as uneven wavering lines that merge, thin out, or trail off without clean edges.
Renders hands as sloppy sketchy shapes where the finger lines wander and the palm loses all structure.
Depicts natural hair growing across the pubic mound and groin on an exposed lower body.
Negative for raw-scan artifacts; fake scan in the positive for a poster or magazine look.
Negative for bleed-through and other scanning defects.
Adds a handwritten artist signature scrawled in a corner of the image.
Negative to remove onomatopoeia text.
Negative to remove speech bubbles, which comic and monochrome tags invite.
Presses a rubber stamp style mark with a border and lettering onto the surface.
Shows a smaller line of text beneath the main title or along the bottom edge.
Places readable or garbled lettering somewhere in the image, often as floating or printed words.
Displays a headline style title in large lettering across the image.
Distorts the subject with unbalanced features, uneven proportions, and a coarse unappealing look.
Distorts the facial features into an unattractive arrangement with uneven eyes, misshapen mouth, and poor proportions.
Negative against a half-drawn look; in the positive with sketch it becomes a style.
Prints an account handle in plain lettering on the image, usually near an edge.
Overlays a semi transparent identifying mark or word across the picture, often centered or tiled.
Produces a badly degraded image with smudged forms, murky color, heavy noise, and unreadable detail.
The low end of the aesthetic scale on Illustrious and NoobAI checkpoints, the counterpart of very aesthetic; in a negative it excludes renders the corpus rated poorly.
Pairs with worst quality in a negative to exclude the low-scoring slice of the training corpus.
Excludes the tell-tale texture of machine-generated images in the corpus: waxy skin, melted detail, incoherent ornament.
Excludes figures fused into each other where two bodies overlap.
Excludes hands and feet rendered with more than the expected number of fingers or toes.
Excludes anatomy that has grown into unrelated shapes.
Excludes faces and bodies with distorted features.
Excludes the corpus slice of images that carry untranslated foreign text: comic panels, captions, and signs.
Excludes wallpaper-format uploads: wide empty margins, centered logos, and desktop-sized compositions.
Negative against malformed feet with twisted toes, broken ankles, and wrong toe counts.
Negative against jagged stair-stepped edges on lines and curves; in the positive it yields a rough pixelated edge look.
Negative against limbs, joints, and bodies bent or attached in impossible ways; in the positive it yields deliberate comic body absurdity.
Negative against a squashed or stretched picture where faces and bodies look wider or taller than they should.
Negative against body parts drawn too large, small, long, or wide relative to each other, such as tiny heads or oversized hands.
Negative against mirror or water reflections that fail to match the figure above them in pose, clothing, or position.
Negative against dithered grainy dots and stepped color banding from a reduced color palette across gradients.
Negative against the off-model look of badly drawn animation frames, with wonky proportions, drifting eyes, and melting faces; in the positive it invites them.
Excludes the flaws of a scanned print: moire dot screens, paper grain, dust specks, color casts, and a dark band along a book's gutter.
Excludes the logo or address stamp of a gallery or wallpaper site laid over the picture, usually in a corner or along an edge.
Negative against misspelled or garbled lettering in any text within the picture; in the positive it puts a visible spelling slip into a sign or caption.
Excludes flat printed patterns such as plaid or florals that ignore folds and body contours; in the positive it gives a deliberately flat stylized print.
Excludes a website URL printed in a corner or along an edge of the picture as a signature or watermark.
Excludes the dark shadowed band, color shift, and blur along one edge that a bound book leaves when scanned without lying flat.
Negative against blocky macroblock compression and stepped color banding, the smeared look of a badly compressed video frame.
Negative against a visible seam or misaligned join where two pictures meet, with lines and colors failing to continue across it.
Negative against stray white specks and dust flecks scattered across the picture like a badly cleaned scan.

Three-dimensional forms built from paper.
Lumpy pasted-paper sculpture surfaces.
Pastel colours, pale pink and blue, without drawing the medium; stable.
Soft blended colour with a chalky surface and grainy edges.
Renders soft chalky strokes in powdery light colors with gentle hazy edges.
Sewn fabric patches in blocks.
Draws the scene in graphite with tonal shading, visible paper grain, and hatched grays.
Loose graphite lines with visible construction and hatching.
A slightly photographic look with a realistic background and a rendered figure.
A portrait in the manner of a photograph.
A single photographic frame.
Arrangement following photographic convention.
Produces an image indistinguishable from a photograph, with true camera optics, natural skin, and physically plausible light.
Painting indistinguishable from a photograph.
Straight photography with lifelike detail.
3D rendering indistinguishable from photography.
Lineless, realistic, high-quality rendering; negative realistic to hold it back.
Reduced symbolic figures as in signage.
Renders the image from visible blocky pixels with a limited palette and crisp stair stepped edges.
Outdoor light painted fast; loose and bright.
Renders bold flat primary colors, thick outlines, halftone dots, and repetition in a commercial art style.
Flat commercial imagery with bold colour and dots.
Smooth glossy white ceramic figures with painted detail.
Studio or location portraits with controlled light.
Bold colour and structured strokes.
Loose design drawings for sets and props.
Heroic figures, bold slogans, limited colour.
Swirling lettering and vibrating colour.
Focus shifting between planes during the shot.
Lurid colour and heavy ink of mid-century pulp covers.
Coiled paper strips forming filigree shapes.
Unidealised everyday subjects painted plainly.
Renders the subject with believable real world anatomy, proportion, and lighting instead of stylization.
Balanced composition, sfumato, and classical figures.
Mid-century cartoon shapes and limited palette.
Grainy spot colours with overlap and misregistration.
Pastel, ornate, playful eighteenth-century elegance.
Soft faces and expressive eyes in mid-century romance comics.
Emotional, dramatic nature and light.
Traced-over live action with realistic motion and wobbly lines.
1920s cartoon look: noodle limbs, pie eyes, gloves.
Repeated flat stamped motifs, slightly uneven.
Pointed exaggeration for social comment.
Sleek machines and space settings in comic ink.
Painted futures, ships, and stations.
Precise, neutral, labelled depiction.
Flat solid colours in separate layers, slightly misregistered.
Adhesive dot and line tones of print manga.
Forms built from dense loose scribbles.
Renders the subject as a carved or molded three dimensional statue form in a single material.
A story told across ordered panels.
Shows the subject as a solid dark shape against a lighter background with no interior detail.
Black silhouettes against lit backgrounds.
Renders loose rough linework with visible construction strokes, unfinished areas, and quick gestural marks.
Motion blurred by a long exposure.
A background rendered soft and unobtrusive.
Green, sunlit, plant-covered futures.
Dabbed, mottled texture from a sponge.
Aerosol gradients, stencils, and drips of street art.
Coloured glass panes with black leading.
Brass, gears, steam, and Victorian dress.
Very fine, dense engraved lines with silvery tone.
Cut-out shapes with bridges, as in stencilled graffiti.
Tone built from dots of ink.
Puppets and sets with the texture of physical materials.
Fabric and wire puppets on model sets.
Quick panels of shots with rough figures and arrows.
Candid urban moments.
Paints with sparse black brush strokes on pale paper, using empty space and gestural economy.
Muscular figures, dynamic poses, bold ink and colour.
Photographic pieces combined into impossible scenes.
Dreamlike impossible scenes painted precisely.
Grainy, high, wide, timestamped footage look.
Grid-based layout, sans type, plenty of white.
Precise ruled lines, orthographic views, and dimension marks.
A long-lens look with flattened depth.
No tempera effect.
Fine, matte, hatched egg tempera with luminous thin layers.

Computer-rendered surfaces with 3D lighting.
Selective focus making scenes look miniature.
3D with flat cel shading and outlines.
Torn-edged paper pieces assembled into an image.

Sketchbook-style places with washed colour.
Flat bold vintage tourism poster look.
A poster carried by type.
Renders Japanese woodblock print art with flat color areas, bold outlines, and layered traditional composition.
Scratchy, satirical, deliberately crude comic drawing.
Blue-green submerged scenes with particles.
Dense generic AI-illustration detail; usable as a face-quality tag.
Pastel gradients, grids, statues, and glitch.

Designed vehicles with mechanical detail.
Darkened corners drawing the eye inward.
The faded tone and softness of an old photograph.
Faded colours and soft focus of old snapshots.
Colour and mood studies for animation.
Forms built from cubic voxels.

Watercolour softness without drawing the medium.

Clean digital comic drawing with flat colour.
American comic rendering, as against manga.
Soft bleeding edges where wet paint met wet paint.
Playful, fanciful drawing with gentle humour.
White lines on a dark ground.

Accurate animal painting in natural setting.
Long-lens animal photographs.
3D shown as edge lines only.
Carved wood with grain and tool marks.
Fine white lines cut into a black ground.
Coarse black shapes and gouged white lines with wood grain.
Woven threads with a stepped, matte image.
Radial blur from a zoom made during exposure.
A pencil-drawn look with grey tonal shading and visible strokes.
A direct ink print of a fish on paper, showing every scale and fin in black ink with a hand-painted eye added.
Renders the scene as folded and cut paper, with layered paper shapes, sharp cut edges, and pop-up depth.

Renders the subject as a folded and glued paper model with sharp creases, flat faceted planes, and matte printed surfaces.
Assembles the whole picture from a grid of hundreds of tiny photographs whose combined tones form the larger image when seen from afar.
Builds the whole picture from countless small dots of pure color that blend optically into forms and tones when viewed at a distance.

Yields rough storyboard-style frames with loosely sketched figures, minimal shading, and timing notes, like a pre-animation mock-up.

Renders the subject as flat ochre and charcoal figures daubed onto rough rock, simplified to outlines and silhouettes.

categories.name: Visual Style Families
categories.description: Terms for named visual movements, genre aesthetics, and stylistic families.

entries.description: Fills the scene with organic grown technology, wet fleshy machinery, veins, membranes, and bioluminescent tissue.
Fills the frame with cathedral arches, stained glass, incense smoke, vestments, and gilded religious iconography.
Bathes a high tech city in neon signage, holograms, rain slicked streets, and glowing circuitry.
Reimagines the interwar era with riveted steel machines, soot, propellers, and heavy industrial machinery.
Pulses the scene with glowing club lighting, lasers, strobes, and abstract digital music visuals.
Mixes dark lace, corsets, silver crosses, and pale skin with torn black streetwear and moody lighting.
Applies traditional Japanese motifs, flat decorative composition, wave and blossom patterns, and calligraphic linework.
Shows a ruined world of crumbling buildings, rusted vehicles, drifting ash, and scavenged makeshift gear.
Melts the frame into swirling saturated colors, kaleidoscope patterns, and hallucinatory flowing shapes.
Renders sleek atomic age spacecraft, chrome fins, glowing energy rays, and retro science fiction futurism.
Imagines the future as past decades saw it, with chrome, tailfins, bubble shapes, and bright optimism.
Saturates the scene with aqua and teal tones, wave and dolphin motifs, and glossy ocean internet graphics.
Coats the scene in glossy translucent goo, dripping slime, bubbling fluids, and wet green translucency.
Fills the frame with worn spacecraft, starfields, asteroid debris, and rough lived in orbital gear.
Dresses the world in brass gears, copper piping, riveted leather, steam vents, and Victorian machinery.
Glows with magenta and blue neon, sunset grid horizons, chrome reflections, and eighties electronic energy.
Rebuilds the world with early electronics, vacuum tubes, exposed circuit boards, and chunky analog machines.
Washes the scene in pink and cyan gradients, marble busts, grid horizons, and eighties computer nostalgia.
Dresses the scene in ornate Victorian fashion, gaslight streets, horse carriages, and elaborate brass gadgetry.
Art deco styling.
Art nouveau styling in the Mucha manner.
A freezing setting with heavy clothing.
Meant as a cool mood; mostly adds heavier clothing and lowers colour temperature a little.
The rounded, wide-eyed style of American studio animation.
Elegance: full long skirts and gothic backdrops.
A fantasy setting; women tend toward princess styling.
Gothic lolita styling: black with red accents and pale skin.
A psychedelic, drug-vision mood.
Horror styling: ghosts, zombies, blood.
A picture built to frighten.
A slight rise in colour temperature; no hot-weather mood.
Cute: pink and light blue, ribbons and frills, a slightly younger subject.
Almost no background, a lone figure, and often no line art.
A forceful mood with weapons, monsters, and more red.
Cute with more dark purple and black and a shadowed expression.
Cute with more pale purple and pink.
The anime and illustration look of the 1980s: soft airbrushed shading, large glossy highlights in the hair, and muted film-grade color.
The anime and illustration look of the 2000s: crisp cel shading, saturated color, and pointed digital line work.
The look of late-1980s and 1990s Japanese PC games: a 16-color dithered palette, hard pixel edges, and flat backgrounds.
Dresses the figure in flowing layered skirts, loose peasant blouses, fringe, floppy hats, and stacked jewelry in earthy tones.
Colors the whole look in brown, cream, and pink like a candy box, with sweets motifs, ruffles, and chocolate-themed accessories.
A refined knee-length dress with a modest neckline, petticoat fullness, and muted florals or solids, worn with a bonnet or headdress in an elegant vintage look.
A softer pastoral take on the frilled petticoat dress, with gingham or fruit prints, straw hats, wicker baskets, and simple aprons.
Dresses the figure in shiny vinyl and reflective fabric, neon and UV colors, goggles, platform boots, and synthetic hair falls in a retro-future club look.
Pairs black clubwear with neon accents, synthetic dreadlocks, goggles, a respirator mask, and industrial straps and buckles.
Piles on hair clips, plastic toys, badges, and layered bracelets over bright mismatched clothes so every surface is covered in colorful accessories.
Dresses the figure like a flying celestial from cave murals, with a bandeau top, flowing pants, long trailing scarves, and gold and jade jewelry.
Mixes chains, mesh tops, striped sleeves, oversized band shirts, chunky skater shoes, and heavy winged eyeliner with dyed or split-color hair.
Puts the figure in tight black skinny jeans, a band tee or striped hoodie, a studded belt, and swept side bangs over heavily lined eyes.
Dresses the figure in fluffy pastel pinks, lavenders, and mints with tulle skirts, oversized sweaters, toy prints, and layered soft accessories.
Dresses the figure in a straight dropped-waist beaded dress with fringe, a bobbed haircut, a jeweled headband, long pearls, and T-strap heels.
A dainty feminine look of lace-trimmed blouses, ribbons, tea-length skirts, berets, and small chain bags in soft cream and pastel tones.
Dresses the figure in black lace, velvet, and leather with corsets, silver crosses, fishnets, and pale makeup with dark lips and eyes.
Puts the figure in a black leather jacket over a white tee, cuffed jeans, boots, and slicked-back pompadour hair, often beside a motorcycle.
Layers a flannel shirt over a faded band tee with ripped jeans, worn combat boots, and unkempt hair in a scruffy nineties look.
Mixes cute pastel outfits and plush mascots with blood spatter, bandages, eyeballs, and grotesque details for a creepy-cute look.
A tanned young man with bleached spiky layered hair, a slim open shirt or vest, tight pants, chains, and pointed shoes.
Floods the outfit with clashing rainbow and primary colors in loud prints, bright tights, and colorful accessories from head to toe.
Dresses the figure in nostalgic nineties and 2000s Japanese girlhood pieces like toy-print tees, colorful plastic hair clips, ruffled socks, and pastel charms.
A princess look with big teased curly hair, a pink and white lace dress with bows and roses, tiaras, and heavy doll-like makeup.
An extravagant princess dress with layered lace, roses, pearls, and a tiara over huge curled hair in pink, white, and gold.
A casual princess look mixing cardigans, tweed skirts, ribbons, and soft pink or beige tones with loosely curled hair and light makeup.
Dresses the figure in baggy jeans, an oversized hoodie or jersey, chunky sneakers, a snapback or beanie, and heavy gold chains.
Puts the figure in tie-dye, bell-bottom jeans, fringed vests, headbands, round sunglasses, beads, and long loose hair with flowers.
Dresses the figure in thick-rimmed glasses, a plaid shirt, skinny jeans, a beanie, and a vintage camera or record, often with a beard.
Blends a frilled petticoat skirt with a short cropped jacket-style top and long ribbon ties taken from Korean court dress, in pastel or muted tones.
Piles on rhinestones, leopard print, low-rise denim, velour tracksuits, big sunglasses, and chunky gold jewelry in a flashy 2000s look.
Dresses the figure in black or olive uniform coats with brass buttons, peaked caps, jackboots, and belts and straps in a strict martial look.
A frilled petticoat dress or skirt combined with a double-breasted uniform jacket, epaulettes, gold braid, and a peaked cap or beret.
Dresses the figure in a bright shift dress or miniskirt, bold geometric prints, a turtleneck, tights, go-go boots, and a sleek short haircut.
Layers loose natural-fiber dresses, cardigans, and lace in cream, brown, and forest tones with woolly socks in a soft fluffy woodland look.
Dresses the figure in a tight pencil skirt, a fitted blouse or blazer, narrow rectangular glasses, sheer tights, and heels in a sultry corporate look.
A boyish aristocratic look of knee-length puffed shorts, a frilled shirt with a cravat, a vest or short jacket, knee socks, and a small top hat.
Pairs black lace, crosses, and bats with pastel pink, lavender, and mint hair and clothes for a dreamy spooky mix.
Combines black goth staples like lace, fishnets, and dark lips with bright colors, playful prints, and a cheerful upbeat mood.
Dresses the figure in a polo shirt or oxford, a sweater tied over the shoulders, chinos or a pleated skirt, loafers, and a blazer with a crest.
Puts the figure in a studded leather jacket, ripped fishnets or plaid pants, safety pins, band patches, heavy boots, and a bright mohawk.
A frilled petticoat skirt in plaid or black mixed with safety pins, chains, studs, torn lace, striped socks, and a small top hat.
A frilled short dress built like a qipao with a mandarin collar, frog buttons, and brocade, worn with a petticoat and Chinese hair ornaments.
Dresses the figure in neon crop tops, fluffy leg warmers, beaded kandi bracelets stacked on the arms, platform boots, and glow sticks.
Sets the scene in early 1800s England with high-waisted empire gowns, bonnets, gloves, tailcoats and cravats, and drawing rooms or ballrooms.
Puts the figure in a polka dot swing dress with a red lip and victory rolls, or a bowling shirt, cuffed jeans, and a pompadour in a fifties diner look.
Fills the scene with pastel silks, wide panniered gowns, powdered wigs, gilded scrolling ornament, and flowers in an ornate 18th century salon.
A tanned girl with big bleached hair and dramatic makeup in black leather, plaid, chains, studs, and band tees with a rock edge.
Sets the scene in the 1830s with wide sloping shoulders, huge puffed gigot sleeves, full skirts, ringlets, and bonnets in a sentimental mood.
Puts the figure in bright neon skinny jeans, cartoon-print tees, lots of plastic accessories, and huge teased multicolored hair with striped raccoon-tail extensions.
A playful late-nineties Harajuku look of clashing bright colors, childish toy accessories, pigtails or buns, and layered mismatched pieces.
Dresses the figure in oversized hoodies, graphic tees, cargo pants or joggers, brand-name sneakers, and a cap in a trendy urban look.
A darker take on the pink and black jirai look, swapping frilly blouses for band tees, mesh, chains, and oversized streetwear in black with dyed hair.
A pastel knee-length dress bursting with lace, bows, and candy or animal prints over a full petticoat, with a bonnet and doll-like styling.
Dresses the figure in black technical fabric with many pockets, straps, zippers, and buckles, layered over skin-tight base garments in a functional look.
Colors the whole look in light blue and white with angel wings, halos, clouds, water motifs, pill and syringe charms, and glossy tech accessories.
Puts the figure in all black with heavy black eye makeup over white face paint, huge teased hair, fishnets, and ankh or cross jewelry.
Dresses the figure in peter pan collars, cardigans, knee-length skirts, tights, Mary Jane shoes, and quirky prints in a sweet vintage look.
Dresses the figure in shiny pastel metallic fabric, sixties space-age silhouettes, planet and alien motifs, and holographic accessories.
Sets the scene in 19th century England with corseted bustle gowns, top hats and frock coats, lace, gaslit streets, and heavy ornate interiors.
Mixes a long slit tunic or a wide-sleeved court robe with a frilled petticoat skirt, lace, and a flat round hat in Vietnamese-styled colors and motifs.
Dresses the figure in flamboyant gothic rock stagewear with heavy makeup, big dyed teased hair, leather, lace, and androgynous glamour.
Pairs a kimono or yukata top with a short frilled petticoat skirt, an obi bow, and lace, in a hybrid of Japanese dress and frilly fashion.
A childlike handmade look of mismatched bright colors, crafted felt and bead accessories, quirky prints, and playful DIY details.
Dresses the figure in low-rise jeans, baby tees, metallic and holographic fabrics, butterfly clips, tinted sunglasses, and chunky sneakers in an early 2000s look.
Mixes baggy pants, cropped tops, bold graphic streetwear, dyed hair, and piercings in a rebellious Chinese underground club look.
Fills the scene with dreamlike impossible imagery: melting or floating objects, mismatched scales, and things combined in ways that defy physics.
Draws the picture in a 1920s manner, with flat inky shapes, art deco lines, and period dress and hair.
Draws the picture in a 1930s manner, with soft rounded cartoon forms, heavy inking, and sepia toned color.
Draws the picture in a 1940s manner, with clean cel inking, muted color, and period hair and clothing.
Draws the picture in a 1950s manner, with bright flat midcentury color, bold outlines, and retro advertising shapes.
Draws the picture in a 1960s manner, with sharp pointed features, tall shining eyes, and flat poster color.
Draws the picture in a 1970s manner, with slender figures, huge sparkling eyes, feathered hair, and soft faded color.
Draws the picture in a 1990s anime manner, with hand painted cel shading, warm film grain, and period outfits.
Fills the frame with rave flyer graphics, warped chrome type, lurid gradients, and clashing layered stickers.
Blends African dress, pattern, and architecture with gleaming science fiction technology and cosmic color.
Breaks the subject into faceted geometric planes and reassembles them so several angles show at once.
Covers the design in thin sharp blackwork spikes and tribal glyphs with an occult cyber edge.
Bathes sleek futuristic forms in warm orange and red daylight with glossy highlights and clean curves.
Mixes glossy glass, water drops, and bubbles with lush green nature, blue sky, and clean 2000s interface shine.
Layers flat minimal shapes over swirling psychedelic vectors, glossy gradients, and bright bloom.
Sets stylish youth in a graffitied urban skate scene with street clothes, bold color, and Y2K futurism.
Imagines the future as the past pictured it, with rounded chrome machines, ray guns, and space age optimism.
Glossy girly 2000s fashion graphics built on stylized high heels, hot pink and black glitter, and leopard accents.
Blends East Asian and Pacific craft in silk, bamboo, paper, and lacquer with inventive retro machinery.
Fills the scene with sunlit greenery climbing bright buildings, solar panels, and airy optimistic architecture.
Flattens everything into glossy poster color with cheerful manga motifs that tip slightly into the surreal.
Turns nostalgic low quality snapshots uneasy, with dim flash light, odd empty spaces, and dreamlike distortion.

categories.name: Camera Viewpoint Directions
categories.description: Terms that specify the direction from which the subject is viewed.

entries.description: Strongly tilts the camera downward, looking well down at the subject from high above at a steep angle. Naming the surface the camera faces (floor) deepens the angle further and keeps the scene indoors; on tag checkpoints this reaches a steep look-down, not an orthographic top view.

Tilts steeply upward from a low vantage, exaggerating height and showing the underside of the subject. Naming the surface the camera faces (ceiling) deepens the angle further and keeps the scene indoors; on tag checkpoints this reaches a steep look-up, not a view from directly beneath.
Angles the camera downward from above so the head and shoulders dominate and the ground shows behind.
Positions the camera behind the subject, showing the back of the head and body with the face hidden.
Points the camera upward from below so the subject looms and the sky or ceiling fills the background.
Places the camera straight up beneath the subject, showing the underside with strong upward perspective.
Places the camera directly in front of the subject so the face and chest face the viewer square on.
Places the camera high overhead pointing straight down, compressing the body and spreading the floor around it.
Positions the camera to the side of the subject, showing the profile turned edge on toward the lens.
Shoots from above eye level looking down, making the subject appear smaller and revealing the ground around it.
Shoots from below eye level looking up, making the subject tower imposingly against the sky or ceiling.
Frames the scene from directly above looking down, showing the top of the head and the surrounding ground.
Composes from behind the character; a partial profile of the face often remains and the eyes may still turn toward the viewer. Facing away is the near synonym.
Camera at the height of the subject's eyes; the effect is slight and often not visible.
The frame stands in for a participant's own eyes.
A moderate look-down from diagonally above. Weight it and name the floor to steepen the angle toward a ceiling-height view.
A moderate look-up from diagonally below. Weight it and name the ceiling to steepen the angle toward a floor-level view.
Camera in front of the subject during an interaction.
Looks out from inside a room, vehicle, or other enclosure through a window or doorway at a subject outside.
Looks into a room from outside through a window or doorway; the character often appears peering out across the frame.
Composes from the side, like side view; add profile when a clean profile of the head is the point.
A low camera looking diagonally upward, close in effect to from below.
A shot past one shoulder from slightly behind. Alone it tends to be misread as off-shoulder clothing; combine with looking back or a back tag.
Camera behind the subject. Prefer this explicit form over a bare direction word attached to a body part, which can be read as a body region instead.
Composes from the side; a landscape canvas tends to give a profile head, a portrait canvas a bust, and the gaze stays forward unless directed.
Frames the character dead centre from the front, which pulls the pose toward left-right symmetry; use front view instead when a slight head tilt or other natural asymmetry is wanted.
A pose turned midway between straight-on and profile. The tag is weak on its own; pairing straight-on and from side across positive and negative can hold it.
The subject seen from behind.

categories.name: Camera Angle and Perspective
categories.description: Terms for camera tilt, perspective, foreshortening, and viewpoint construction.

entries.description: A steep view from high above, the ground filling the frame.
Defocused background plane; pairs with depth of field.
Near-plane defocus framing.
A view from directly below the subject.
The frame tilted off level, a dutch angle.
Composes with widescreen film style framing, shallow depth, and a deliberate dramatic camera placement.
A long lens flattening distance so far and near objects sit close together.
Strong perspective with lines converging far into the frame.
Focus falloff separating subject from background.
Composes from an extreme tilted or steep viewpoint that heightens tension and visual impact.
Aggressive near-limb enlargement for looming or reaching poses.
A high aerial view as from a drone, looking down or across.
Tilted camera roll for tension or energy.
A tilted horizon; the dutch angle.
The camera rolled so the horizon slopes.
Uses an energetic diagonal viewpoint with strong perspective lines that make the pose feel in motion.
The camera far below the subject looking sharply up.
Camera far below the subject, looking steeply up.
Exaggerated perspective with strong convergence and foreshortening.
The camera at the subject's eye height.
Meant as a view through spectacles, but in practice only adds glasses to the character.
Barrel-distortion wide lens look.
Warps the frame with extreme barrel distortion, curving straight lines and bulging the center outward.
Little depth; the scene reads as layers on a plane.
Scale tricks by placement: near objects made to read as large.
Strong near-limb perspective enlargement.
Curved, fisheye-like perspective with four vanishing points.
The subject seen square from the front.
The camera above the subject looking down.
A view from above the subject.
Framing that places the viewer inside the scene's space.
A forceful, dramatic camera angle; the expression tightens with it.
A parallel projection at equal angles, as in isometric game art.
Frames the subject small within a wide surrounding environment, showing the whole body and its setting.
A view from below the subject.
The camera near the ground.
Movement streak effect.
Compresses the scene with a tight telephoto view, flattening depth and isolating the subject.
Immersive viewer-position framing beneath the subject.
Lines converging to a single vanishing point ahead.
The frame past one person's shoulder toward another.
Frames the subject from behind a foreground shoulder that cuts into the near edge of the frame.
A view from directly above.
Emphasized depth perspective.
Depth conveyed by converging lines.
The frame as seen through a character's eyes.
Shows the scene through the eyes of a character, with their own hands or body edges entering the frame.
A side view of the face or body.

Two figures arranged in a rotated, yin-yang-like composition. Often fails, since inverting one figure is still hard; supporting tags such as circle formation, fetal position, sleeping, and on side help.
Composition cue emphasizing the subject's size against the frame.
Little depth; near and far compressed together.
A strict side view of the head.
The whole image rotated ninety degrees onto its side.
A high fixed camera's view, wide and impersonal.
The character faces the viewer in a mirror-symmetric arrangement; with two characters both fall into matching twin-like poses.
The subject turned about forty-five degrees from the camera.
The frame rolled off level.
A view straight down from above.
Lines converging to two vanishing points at the sides.
The figure inverted, head down and legs up. Renders more often as a flipped camera or a lying figure shot from the far side than as a handstand.
Explicit convergence-point perspective.
The position the picture is seen from; a general term that needs a specific angle beside it.
Captures a broad field of view with exaggerated perspective and space stretching toward the frame edges.
A wide field of view that stretches what is near the edges.
A view from ground level looking up.
Places the subject or viewpoint far above the ground, on a rooftop, cliff, or tower, with a long drop and a distant floor below.

categories.name: Subject Framing and Focus
categories.description: Terms that determine which part of the subject receives compositional emphasis.

entries.description: An arrangement read as shapes and tones rather than as a scene.
An animal as the main subject; name the species.
Armpits emphasized suggestively, with arms raised and a suggestive touch.
Frames the buttocks prominently in close view, rounded and emphasized, often in tight clothing or nude.
A close rear framing on the buttocks; ass rather than hip for that meaning.
Visual weight placed off balance across the frame on purpose.
Distance shown by haze, softening, and cooler tone toward the far ground.
Centers attention on the back of the body, shown turned away and rendered in sharp detail.
Weight spread evenly across the frame; calm and stable.
The chest emphasized; cleavage for the cleft specifically.
The subject placed in the middle of the frame.
The subject in the centre of the frame with even margins.
Deliberately crowded and disordered arrangement.
Stresses the character over the setting.
Frames tightly on the chest, filling the composition with the torso and its clothing or skin detail.
Draws attention to the chest, rendered sharply while the surroundings soften.
Film-like framing: wide aspect, headroom and lead room by convention, deliberate light.
A plain, uncluttered background.
Frames tightly on the subject so the face or a detail fills most of the image.
A tight framing that, undirected, tends to show only the region around the eyes; a backlit look with shadowed face and lit nose is a common side effect.
A busy background full of objects and detail.
A picture whose purpose is the arrangement itself; often loose and sketch-like.
The frame's weights held in equilibrium.
Enough setting kept in the frame to place the subject in a scene.
The subject set into a corner of the frame with empty space opposite.
A couple drawn as equal subjects rather than one partner cropped at the edge; occasionally a same-sex pair.
Frames the subject from roughly mid-thigh upward; some models may also introduce a cowboy hat.
The arms are cut by the frame, usually below the elbow.
Parts of the subject cut by the frame edge on purpose.
Only the head within the frame; a weak tag.
The legs run out of the frame partway down.
Head to shoulder line only, as if floating.
The torso is cut by the frame edge, showing only the upper body region.
Any device that shows depth: overlap, size change, haze, focus.
Foreground, middle ground, and background as distinct layers.
The main lines of the picture running on a diagonal.
Diagonal lines dominating the arrangement, giving movement.

Spreads flushed pink coloring across the chest, shoulders, and limbs as well as the face.
Hands, feet, or whole limbs in a different color from the rest of the body, fading in or cutting sharply at the join.
Renders a female figure with deep brown skin across the face and body.
Pale part transparent hands, usually disembodied or reaching in from outside the frame.
Gives some or all of the skin a polished metal surface with hard reflections and visible seams.
Colors the skin a flat unnatural orange, well past any tan.
Skin built from mismatched pieces sewn together, with visible stitch lines and tone shifts between patches.
Colors the skin an unnatural flat pink across the whole body.
Gives the skin a smooth molded plastic surface with glossy highlights and doll like joint lines.
Black part transparent hands, usually disembodied or reaching out of a figure kept out of frame.
Colors the skin a pale metallic silver across the body.
Pale depigmented patches scattered across the skin with soft irregular borders.
Colors the skin a flat unnatural yellow rather than a merely pale tone.
An inked design marked permanently into the skin, its lines following the curve of the body.

categories.name: Body Build

A pleasantly plump body with soft rounded cheeks, a small belly, and gently thickened limbs.
A pronounced hourglass figure with a narrow waist, full rounded hips, and a generously filled bust.
A massively muscled body with straining veins, bulging muscles, and a physique at the edge of natural size.
A visibly heavy body with a soft rounded belly, thick limbs, and fullness spread across the frame.
Draws the face and body hollowed, with sunken cheeks, prominent bones, and tight skin.
A thick, burly build with a broad chest, heavy arms, and a solid layer of bulk overall.
An impossibly exaggerated body whose gigantic muscles dwarf the head and bulge far beyond human proportions.
A clearly fit body with developed shoulders, arms, and chest, without extreme bulk.
An extremely massive body with an enormous hanging belly, very thick limbs, and deeply padded features.
A very heavy body with a large sagging belly, thick limbs, and flesh pressing against clothing.
A noticeably heavy figure with a soft midsection, rounded features, and weight carried evenly over the body.
A soft, rounded body with full cheeks, a gentle belly, and comfortably thick arms and legs.
Draws a gracefully thin body with a narrow waist, fine limbs, and elegant light proportions.
A mostly slim body with faint muscle lines on the arms and a lightly firm stomach.
A short, solidly thick body with a barrel chest, rounded belly, and sturdy limbs.
A firm, lightly muscled body with subtle definition along the arms, stomach, and legs.
A heavily muscled physique with pronounced pecs, bulging arms, and defined abs across the torso.
A bare midriff showing a firm segmented six-pack stomach with shadowed grooves between the muscles.
A muscularity different from the source design; the face stays and the body below the neck bulks up.
The back is the noted feature.
A heavily muscled back, which forces a from-behind view.
Prominent upper-arm muscle.
A large rounded stomach.
Meant to enlarge the head chibi-style; no effect on the tested model.
The whole body is the subject.
The body runs past the edge of the picture.
Separate parts of a body shown apart from it.
Contest-style hypertrophy with pronounced separation between muscle groups.
An arm hanging at a wrong angle or in a cast.
Fingers bent the wrong way.
Broad heavy-framed strength without cut definition.
A tiny stylized figure with an oversized head, small body, stubby limbs, and simplified cute features.
The character with a chibi version of themselves in the same picture, as on a game character screen; with inpainting it can produce the chibi version of a character.
Only the chibi version, without the full-size character.
An extremely fat, massive body with folds of flesh gathering around an enormous belly.
A soft, rounded body with gentle proportions, large expressive eyes, and an endearing childlike charm.
Simplified, chibi-like proportions.
Soles marked with dirt.
A chest out of scale with the rest of the body; oppailoli is the youthful-face variant.
The feet are the noted feature.
Only the feet are in the picture.
The feet fall outside the picture.
The fingers are the noted feature.
Draws a toned athletic body with visible muscle definition and healthy firm contours.
Flat buttocks emphasized.
A foot is the noted feature.
Hands out of proportion to the body.
An enormous chest beyond huge; often overflows the frame and breaks.
A polished, alluring figure posed with confident elegance in luxurious clothing, jewelry, and flawless styling.
Visible tendons along the inner thigh, pulling focus to the groin.
Only half the head is in the picture.
A hand is the noted feature.
The head is the noted feature.
A broad, solidly built figure with a thick torso, wide frame, and substantial overall weight.
Prominent hip bones.
A chest hanging bell-shaped under gravity when the figure leans forward.
Deliberately exaggerated scale of a body feature, well past the plausible range.
Hands drawn large against the body.
The bigger of two male subjects; useful for stating a size relationship in a pairing.
A leg is the noted feature.
The legs are the noted feature.
A chest about large in size but drawn slightly elongated; only readable unclothed.
A man's arm entering the picture.
A man's body.
A man's hand entering the picture.
A man's hands entering the picture.
Arms built of metal joints.
An average, balanced build with neither prominent curves nor visible muscle, fitting naturally in most clothing.
Unstable: sometimes chibi proportions, sometimes an ordinary small girl.
A tiny person rather than a chibi, shown against hands or objects for scale.
Envy of another's muscles, the muscular counterpart of breast envy.
A heavy muscular build carrying a rounded belly over the abdominal wall; a distinct mass tier between toned and simply overweight.
A visibly muscular build with defined muscle shape across the body.
A woman with heavy visible muscle.
A man with heavy visible muscle.
The neck is the noted feature.
Prominent oblique muscles at the flanks, on a very muscular body.
Male subject carrying substantial body fat.
With 1boy, prominent chest muscles; the breast-modifier tags generally carry over as pectoral variants, and the whole body turns muscular.
A sumo-like build, muscular arms on a plump body.
A dignified, heavyset middle-aged build with a prominent round belly and a broad solid stance.
An artificial arm.
Visible ribs from thinness; alone it can turn skeletal, so pair with skinny and completely nude.
An arm built of metal joints.
A very round, bulging body whose large protruding belly dominates the whole silhouette.
Draws a bony underfed body with jutting ribs, knobby joints, and thin stringy limbs.
Draws a very thin body with visible bone contours and little flesh or muscle.
Draws a lean trim body with a flat waist and light toned definition.
Very thin legs, edging toward emaciated; moderate the weight.
A narrow, cinched waist, and a framing that shows it.
The smaller of two male subjects.
A powerfully built figure with visible muscle mass, a firm planted stance, and physical presence suggesting strength.
A thick, solid midsection like a wrestler rather than a cut one.
A gap between the thighs with the legs closed; gives slimmer legs more gracefully than slim legs.
The thighs are the noted feature.
The toes are the noted feature.
A lean, toned man.
A very thin, frail body with prominent bones, narrow limbs, and little flesh over the ribs.
Meant as the inverted-triangle torso but only produces a V sign.
Draws a frail body with little muscle, thin arms, and a slumped fragile posture.
A softly rounded plump stomach, fuller than flat but short of a heavy paunch.
A faint vertical line running up the center of the abdomen above the navel, marking lean muscle definition.
The vertical groove down the center of the back where the spine sits between the flanking muscles.
A tightly tapered waist cinching in sharply between the ribs and the hips.
The bare front of the abdomen around the navel, shown between the chest and the waistband.
Heavy thick arms carrying substantial mass through the upper arm and forearm.
A wide shoulder line squaring off the upper body, reading as strong and masculine.
The two flat triangular bones of the upper back showing their shape through the skin.

categories.name: Bust and Chest
categories.description: Terms and phrases related to bust and chest.

entries.description: A plentiful, rounded bust with soft curves and a deep shadowed valley of cleavage.
A bouncing chest, sometimes with motion lines.
A character self-conscious about the own chest size, with a matching gesture.
Sulky envy of another's chest, looking down at the own.
Arms folded under the chest, emphasizing size.
The chest lifted by the hands or arms.
The chest pressed down from above.
The chest set apart with a visible gap.
The chest pressed together by hands or arms.
A size-comparison chart of several characters.
Measuring the chest with a tape.
A woman with noticeably large, full breasts that swell prominently against her top.
The deep shadowed valley between large breasts exposed by a low-cut neckline.
A woman with a smooth, nearly flat chest and no visible breast projection under her clothing.
A chest lifted against gravity.
Legs folded to one side in the Japanese sit.
A rounded, generously filled chest with a complete heavy breast silhouette and soft cleavage.
Sexual touching, usually a chest grabbed from behind.
A heavy bell-shaped chest, fetishistic.
A large, weighty bust that sits low and pulls the fabric of the clothing downward.
Enormous breasts far larger than the torso naturally allows, bulging and straining every garment.
Enormous heavy breasts that hang low and droop downward under their own weight, stretching the clothing.
A woman with big, heavy breasts that curve outward and strain the fabric of her clothing.
A woman with moderate, naturally proportioned breasts that fill the chest without straining her clothing.
An upturned, assertive chest of moderate size; opposite of sagging breasts.
A conical chest pushed out of tight clothing, which tends to constrict elsewhere too.
A heavy, drooping chest; opposite of perky breasts.
The soft outer curve of a breast visible from the side beyond the edge of the garment.
A woman with small, subtly rounded breasts that barely rise from the chest line.
A full side split seated flat on the floor.
A chest pointing in two directions.
The lower curve of the breasts exposed beneath a raised top or cropped shirt.
Meant as veins on the chest; in practice produced a bra showing through clothing.
A sensually full figure with large soft breasts, wide hips, and a deep hourglass waist.
A woman with very large breasts that dominate her silhouette and overflow her clothing.
Small raised bumps scattered over the areola around the nipple, giving that skin a finely pebbled texture.
Small neat nipples with narrow areolae, barely raised from the chest.

categories.name: Hips and Glutes
categories.description: Terms and phrases related to hips and glutes.

entries.description: A large, full behind with pronounced rounded volume.
Wide, curvy hips that flare prominently from the waist and fill out the clothing.
The vertical crease between the bare buttocks, visible from behind in a rear view.
Enormously wide hips that flare far beyond the waist and dominate the lower silhouette.
Hips set low on the body, sitting just above the thighs with a drooping curve.
Naturally proportioned hips with a gentle moderate curve between waist and thighs.
Narrow hips that barely widen past the waist, running in a subtle straight line to the thighs.
Two small indentations on the lower back just above the buttocks, emphasized on bare skin.
Hips notably broader than the waist, flaring outward.
The crease where the thighs meet the torso, drawn visible below the waistband or above the leg line.
Two small symmetrical dimples on the lower back just above the buttocks, catching soft shadow.
Slight inward notches at the sides of the pelvis that break the line from waist to thigh.

categories.name: Leg Proportions
categories.description: Terms and phrases related to leg proportions.

entries.description: Thick, fleshy legs with heavy thighs and calves pressed close together.
Exceptionally long, slender legs taking up most of the height below the torso.
Noticeably short legs relative to the torso, giving a compact, squat stance.
Full, thick thighs with substantial soft volume.
The soft hollow behind the knee, exposed when the leg bends or lifts toward the viewer.
Draws the knees clearly, with the kneecap and its creases defined on the front of the leg.

categories.name: General Poses
categories.description: Broad terms for pose type and body presentation.

entries.description: A body frozen mid-motion in a dramatic combat or movement stance with limbs extended.
A sporty balanced stance with tensed muscles, planted feet, and the energy of a competitor.
A classical standing pose with weight on one leg, tilted hips, and counter-rotated shoulders.
A body twisted mid-movement with diagonal limbs, flowing hair, and strong energy across the frame.
A triumphant stance with chest out, chin raised, and cape or hair sweeping dramatically behind.
A dominant stance with squared shoulders, planted feet, and flexed arms projecting raw strength.
A cheeky confident stance with one hip cocked, a hand thrust out, and the chin lifted.
A fashionably arranged stance with angled limbs, elegant posture, and model-like poise.
The 3D rigging A-pose with arms lowered in a V; weak, so arms at sides is the better way to drop the arms naturally.
An acrobatic pose that tends to add gymnastics costume and to break anatomy.
Meant as a floating pose but tends to produce an aerial view of the ground from above.
The character pressing toward the viewer as if against the picture surface; cheek press or hand on glass help.
Looking through glass toward the viewer; against window for leaning on a window.
Positioned against a wall.
Aiming a weapon, a handgun unless holding names another; aiming at viewer aims at the camera. Pointing is the finger.
The back curved backwards.
The upper body arched backward; with shaft look it becomes the back-arched glance toward the viewer.
An arm raised so the underarm is visible.
Arms wrapped around another's waist from the front or behind.
Both arms folded up behind the head.
A rear view where the bare buttocks peek out between the gaps of spread thighs.
Someone held at gunpoint; the character may be on either side, so it is hard to control.
Light rising from the body, purple or red unless a colour is set; powering_up for charging.
A low crouch with one hand resting on a sheathed katana, ready to draw in an instant.
The body bent at the waist.
The upper body leaning back in a curve.
Bent forward at the waist like a toe-touch; the opposite of leaning back.
The figure is tied.
The ankles are tied together.
The arms are tied.
The legs are tied.
Two figures tied to each other.
The wrists are tied.
A bow, sometimes deepening to a kneeling apology with a second figure.
The chest pressed against glass.
A settled, untroubled face with relaxed brows and mouth.
A comic brawl between women, usually bare-handed guards.
A spark effect at the moment an attack lands.
A couple sitting side by side, often becoming a lap sit depending on framing; state the count exactly.
A hand or cloth covers part of the body.
A hand held over the mouth.
Body lowered on bent legs with the weight over the feet; lower than a squat's rest and ready to move.
The whole body drawn into a curve with the knees up and the head low; sleeping or sheltering.
Dancing; without a costume stated it adds dancer clothing and sometimes a stage.
A weapon in each hand; two-handed is one weapon in both hands.
A duel, with a swinging weapon and glowing effects.
Electricity crackling from the body.
A ball of attack light with a psychic rather than fantasy feel; powering_up for charging.
A comic face-first collapse onto the ground.
The face turned toward another character, taking the gaze off the camera.
The back of the head toward the viewer with the eyes hidden, as distinct from looking away; often still shows the eyes, so add no eyes.
The face turned to the rear without a stated gaze; unstable but turns the head away.
The face pointed down.
The face turned to the side relative to the body; a weak tag.
The chin raised and the face pointed up; the gaze does not always follow.
The face pointed the way the body faces, as distinct from straight-on, which places the camera.
A free-fall pose as if dropping from the sky.
The figure is falling.
Fighting; alone it is random, giving a brawl or a weapon stance.
A guard with the hands raised and the body angled; the tag the furry side uses where a fighting stance is meant.
A combat-ready pose with knees bent, fists raised, and the body braced to strike or dodge.
The finger-gun-to-own-head gesture.
A finger on the trigger; unstable. Trigger_discipline keeps it off.
Firing a gun, usually with a muzzle flash.
Clothes and hair lifting against gravity as if from released power; floating skirt and similar variants work.
An object floating in the air, cube-like magic shapes if none is named.
Food held between the lips or teeth.
A frying pan as a held or placed prop, usually on a hob.
A sideways gun grip; no effect alone.
A gun held to the head, usually from off-frame; surrounded for a ring of attackers.
A hand pressed against glass.
One hand placed on a wall.
The hands as the frame's subject; a close on them isolates them from the body, so name their construction beside the tag.
The figure or object hangs from something.
Arms or legs dangling loosely.
The head tipped back on the neck so the chin rises and the throat shows.
The head turned to face behind.
One character's head resting on another's shoulder.
The head rotated away from the body's facing so the face reads at an angle to the chest.
Heels lifted naturally rather than a full tiptoe; only the legs may be drawn.
A high kick; limbs can distort.
The figure holds a camera.
A hand holding a hen's egg.
Holding a gun; pair with aiming to point it forward.
The figure holds a sword.
A gun in its holster; without clothing tags it turns military or western.
A light one-footed hop; unstable.
Riding a horse; the rider tends to drift toward a horse-girl design.
A rounded, hunched back with less forward weight than leaning forward; pairs with fidgeting.
The subject is inside a box.
The wall-slam pose; with 1girl it is seen from the pinned side, and from side gives a third-person view.
A kick; some models draw it poorly.
A kiss placed on the cheek rather than the mouth.
One knee bent. With full body and standing it gives the game-illustration standing pose with one bent leg as an accent; with sitting it raises one knee. Leg up bends the leg further.
Torso tilted off the vertical in any direction; combine with the surface or direction it leans toward.
Leaning the back against something; on the floor it becomes on back, and against a wall use leaning back with against wall.
Torso tilted back from the hips, chest open, often with a hand or elbow taking the weight behind.
One elbow planted on a surface with the head or torso propped on it.
Leaning on a named object such as a bike, wall, or weapon; the against tags for specific objects can work better.
Head or neck resting against another character, an intimate lean on the shoulder.
Forearms or hands on a table or counter taking the upper body's weight; the closest common tag for a figure at a kitchen counter.
Shoulder or back set against a wall with the weight on it; a waiting or idle stance.
The whole body tilted to one side with weight shifted, the full-body version of head tilt.
A faint flush across the cheeks, lighter than a full blush.
The figure lies face up.
The body lying on one side, as in sleep; the upper side faces the camera.
A ball of attack light in the hand, with witch-like clothing as a side effect.
A magic circle in the background or underfoot.
The body off the ground mid-jump or mid-fall; levitation is a good alternative.
The flash at the muzzle when firing; if an animal muzzle appears instead, negative it or use firing.
The subject is on a desk.
Lying face down with the chest against the surface.
The subject is on a table.
Standing with feet shoulder-width apart; unlike legs apart it tends to summon a sword or a fighting guard.
A pillow fight, usually just a pillow held.
Display-oriented pose presenting the body toward the viewer.
A psychic effect from the hands.
A flurry of punches drawn in the air; unstable.
A hand reaching for a holstered gun or sheathed sword; no effect.
Reclined with the weight back, often lying on a sofa; leaning back is easier to control.
Reloading a gun; the motion is loosely drawn.
At rest without sleep: the body settled onto a surface, limbs slack.
Shirt sleeves rolled up the forearm.
A hand rubbing one eye, the gesture of sleepiness or tears.
A pose held to look alluring.
A shirt; a colour word before it sets the colour (light blue shirt) and a cut word the kind (button shirt).
Singing, which brings a microphone, a smile, and cinematic lighting.
The figure sits on a couch.
A weapon slash with a big effect; pair with holding and the weapon.
A forward slump that tends to read as a pensive thinker pose.
Nose lifted or pushed toward something, nostrils working.
A snowball fight, a bundled-up character holding a snowball.
One foot ahead and weight in transfer, mid-step rather than planted.
A hand at the chin in thought.
The figure hangs clear of the ground.
A model stance with hips forward and back arched, but it often lands as a plain back view.
A drawn-sword guard stance; weak.
The 3D rigging T-pose, arms straight out to the sides.
Psychic force, usually a magical flame in the hand.
Lying on the front with the lower legs raised, the classic pin-up pose; pairs with head rest.
The figure is tied with rope.
The figure is bound, with no sexual reading.
Standing on tiptoe; tiptoes kiss gives a tiptoe kiss but the girl tends to come out taller, and only the legs may be drawn.
The finger held off the trigger.
The head turned to the side or rear; weak.
The torso twisted at the waist; can fail alone, so pair with looking back.
One weapon held in both hands, gun or sword.
The face inverted, which tends to flip the whole picture.
The figure is seen from behind.
The moment of waking: eyes half open, body still partly in the sleeping position, often a stretch or a rub of the eyes.
Feet set well apart, weight centred; a braced or planted stance.
Wrestling, with ring and wrestling gear.
Mouth open wide in a yawn, eyes narrowed or closed.
A neutral standing reference pose with the arms held straight and angled slightly down from the sides, like the letter A.
On hands and feet with the knees raised off the ground, back held flat and horizontal like a standing four-legged animal.
The back curves forward into a C shape as the torso folds ahead, the middle of the spine the highest point.
The body arched face-up on hands and feet, the belly lifted as the highest point in a gymnastic bridge.
A contortion pose with the chest on the ground and the back arched over until the legs hang in front of the head.
An extreme contortion where the body is lifted on the hands or elbows and the back arched so the legs hang in front of the head.
The figure crouches low in fear, shoulders hunched and arms raised to shield the face.
A figure bound or nailed to a cross with the arms spread wide along the crossbar and the head hanging.
Tenses the arms and torso in a muscle showing pose, biceps balled up and definition standing out across the body.
Lifts the figure off the ground to hover in midair with no visible support, hair and clothing drifting loosely.
Plants the face and chest on the ground with the back arched so the feet swing forward over the head like a scorpion tail.
Balances the body upside down with the crown of the head on the floor and the legs raised straight overhead.
Snaps the body into a dramatic transformation stance with the arms locked in a sharp angular shape and every muscle taut.
Wraps both arms around a tail and holds it against the chest, either the figure's own tail or a companion's.
Bends the arms and body into the shape of a written letter, as in the raised arm shapes of the YMCA dance.
Sits low on the ground with the front knee bent across the body and the back leg stretched straight behind in a yoga stretch.
Stands with both arms raised overhead in a wide open V, palms up and the face tipped toward a blazing sun.

Stands and arches the back so far that the head comes through between the thighs from behind.
Balances on the hands or forearms with the back arched and the bent legs curling forward over the head.
Stands with the arms held straight out to the sides at shoulder height and the legs straight down, face blank and neutral.
Bends the body up from a chest stand until the shins fold down parallel to the floor above the head.

Sitting with one leg folded over the other, knees stacked in a relaxed cross.
